Why this site exists

This site documents lighting conditions along this public trail and surrounding recreational area, including the location of nonfunctioning or poorly functioning lights and the site of a serious nighttime bicycle accident.

The goal is simple: have the lighting repaired and maintained, or make nighttime access restrictions and warnings clear enough that people are not unknowingly exposed to avoidable hazards.

The map includes photographs, video, GPS information, and the identified accident location. It is intended as a factual record of the conditions observed.
